comment: Omberg's zone palettes (CONTEXT.md 'Model library'): each item refers to a model of models.json ("model") and keeps where and how densely it grows and its size; the look (healthy / dry, the shader "material" floats, randomDarkening, ...) is the model's, set once for every zone that uses it (bun run models -- look). The model's renderer decides who draws the item: a vsp model the course's own VSP, an arborist model Arborist's lower-vegetation package. Swap one: bun run models -- zone "Ombergs Golfklubb" <palette key> "<item>" --model <id>. Migrated from the prefab/source form 2026-10-21 (heather, lingonberry, bilberry and fern stay VSP: Arborist stores no _BackFaceMirrorNormal).

palettes.comment: Drawn to the full 300 m, thinning out evenly from 45 m (distanceFalloff 0.15), 2026-10-15: hard render distances (90 m, copies to 30/60 m) gave extreme pop-in in GreenKeeper. Green is the bulk, straw/brown the accent (Marcus 2026-10-15): in every tall rough mix the green items have distance copies (the carpet item to 15 and 30 m, the other green items to 30 m; each copy thins from 15% of its distance, so about 3x at 3 m and 1x at 30 m, no line) and their tints were moved 6 deg toward green and 15% darker, toward the ground mesh as rendered (hue 67, value 0.3), for a better blend and less pop-in. The accents have no copies and keep their tints. 2026-10-16 (Marcus): the VSP grass 30 % thicker within 30 m of play on Omberg, which has far fewer trees than Vreta and GPU budget for it: every texture item's sampleDistance divided by sqrt(1.3) (x0.877; the mask values cap at maxDensity 1, so the density has to come from the spacing), and the tall-grass near rule in vegetation-rules.json thins it back to the old density beyond about 45 m. The far mix (rough_tall/far) is unchanged. 2026-10-17 (Marcus: far too dark against the ortho/OPCD ground, pop-in): the two green items (and the far mix's same two) x1.75 in linear light, measured on hole 1's deep rough (Unity 719/578): ground/grass luminance 1.82 -> 1.02 top-down from 10 m, 1.62 -> 1.04 from his 30 m oblique view. The straw and seed-head accents keep their tints. Then (Marcus: still too much dark grass close up) randomDarkening 0.2 -> 0.3 on the same items: VSP darkens each instance by saturate(random + randomDarkening), so 0.2 left a fifth of the green near black; 0.3 keeps a dark mix, close-up p10 luminance +27 %, still 1.04x the ground from his 30 m view (0.4 read 1.13x there and 1.55x top-down). The distance copies had kept the old tints (the live adjust reached base items only, fixed in GolfMapVegLive). 2026-10-22 (Marcus, Vreta): bright accents thin out only from 70% of the draw distance (their own distanceFalloff 0.7): VSP culls a tuft whole, so from 45 m they popped in one by one; from 210 m a tuft is a few pixels.

The tall rough on dark ground (2026-10-17, Marcus: the brightened mix reads too light on Omberg's dark crop fields): pipeline/grass_zones.py hands the ordinary mix over to this one where Unity's ground render (golfmap.surfaces.ground) is dark. The green items are the ordinary mix's with its tints from before the x1.75 lift (they matched that dark ground); the straw and seed heads are the ordinary mix's own items, shared by name.
The far mix on dark ground (2026-10-17), as rough_tall/dark is the ordinary mix's: its green items with the tints from before the lift, the straw shared by name.

VSP only (Stix wispy retired 2026-10-14). Copies to 30 and 60 m (denser near the camera) over the base drawn to 300 m; every layer thins out evenly from 15% of its own distance (distanceFalloff 0.15) so no layer ends in a line. Density noise off (even spread), spacing x sqrt(2).

Grass and moss in the cracks and on the ledges of the shore rock (pipeline/rock_shore_zones.py, a mix layer on the slab). 2026-10-16: the tall rough's textures and tints, low, at 1.75x the tall rough's density (its spacing after the 2026-10-16 x0.877, then / sqrt(1.75)); copies on the green items only. No moss card or detail prefab in the Omberg project (Forest_detail_moss is Arborist-only): the moss is the green base texture 14 cm tall, tinted darker.

Heather and lingonberry on the ledges and the thin soil beside the shore rock (2026-10-16), the woodland heath's plants and looks. Their names hold 'heather' / 'lingonberry', so the prefabItemsInVsp rule leaves them to the course's VSP (NatureManufacture's grass-shader plants are white from the sun's side in Arborist: docs/gspro/arborist.md).

Low scrub hugging the shore rock and along Vättern (2026-10-16): hazel the bulk, grey willow, maple bush and birch sapling, young and dwarf pines; a little lower than the shrub thicket (wind). The shrub palette's tints and materials. Arborist draws them (prefabItems arborist).

Dry and green grass under and between the shore scrub (2026-10-16, a mix layer): the tall rough's and the fresh rough's textures and tints at 1.75x the tall rough's density (its spacing after the 2026-10-16 x0.877, then / sqrt(1.75)); copies on the green items only.

Submerged leafy grass on Omberg's hole 13 pond bed (2026-10-19): cards at most 0.9 x 1.0 x 1.1 = 0.9 m, the zone is the ortho's weed mat 2.6 m in from the outline, where the flat bed lies 1.2-1.35 m under the water, so the tops stay 0.3-0.45 m below the surface. Tints are light because the water is nearly opaque and dark.

Small, low reed clumps standing in shallow pond water (Omberg pond 576, 2026-10-21, Marcus: "små vass-ruggar här och där, inte jättehöga"): the creek reeds' models (same look) on narrower, shorter cards, 0.7-1.1 m, so in the dig's 0.15-0.4 m shelf water 0.3-0.7 m stands above the surface. Hand-drawn zones 1-1.8 m along the shore, 0.2-0.5 m in.
